world: ⭐⭐⭐ C DOWNGRADED TO UNEVALUABLE — A BLOCK CERTIFIED AS STANDING ONE ROUND AGO RESTS ON A SET RETRACTED THIRTY ROUNDS AGO. R688's finding is 'the 3 published arms outside ③'s extension all fail ② anyway', and its `published` field is exactly PUBLISHED_FIVE — which R689 retracted THE VERY NEXT ROUND. The card names 1 of those 5 (['coval_core']), and at n=1 R688's test CANNOT BE RUN: it needs a set of published arms outside ③'s extension, and the corrected set has 0 such arm. ⭐ SO '§4's FALSIFIER DOES NOT FIRE AGAINST ③' IS DOWNGRADED TO UNEVALUABLE — not refuted, unevaluable, because the population it was computed over is not the release's. ⛔⛔ AND R718's INSTRUMENT WAS STRUCTURALLY BLIND TO THIS: 2 of the blocks touching the retracted literal do not cite R689 or R714 in their own body, so 'no body citation outranks the heading' returned UNAMENDED. AN AMENDMENT TEST SCOPED TO A BLOCK CANNOT SEE A RETRACTION FILED IN A DIFFERENT BLOCK — which means R718's '2 of 12 stand' is an OVERCOUNT, and the residue it reported first is now 1 block. ⚠ THE VERDICT MAY YET SURVIVE: on R360's full 42 arms ③ excludes 37 and excludes-alone 4, so the CLAUSE is not shown to be decoration — what is shown is that R688's EVIDENCE for it was drawn from a withdrawn set. ⚠ UNIT GAP: instrument unit is A CLAIM BLOCK, claim unit is WHETHER A BLOCK'S SUPPORT SURVIVES.
